summary: Full backend + frontend smoke of Brivo admin + public site. 20/20 pytest pass, all UI flows green: analytics beacon fires with brivo_sid in localStorage, inquiry dialog POSTs /api/inquiries, ROI calculator POSTs /api/inquiries/roi, admin auth + 4-tab dashboard + logout + unauth redirect all work, operator tab shows 'Not connected' state and skeleton toasts on toggle/dial (Bland intentionally not configured), 404 works, 0 console errors during user flows.
action_items: (nice-to-have) Add data-testid="roi-email" on the RoiCalculator.jsx email <input> (currently only roi-submit has testid) for more robust automation. Not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~620 lines and mixes public + admin + operator + webhook + chat. Consider splitting into routers (inquiries.py, admin.py, operator.py, webhooks.py) once skeleton stabilises — not a bug, just maintainability.

auth.py reads os.environ['JWT_SECRET'] at call-time via _secret() — good, but there is no enforcement that the value is non-empty. If someone clears JWT_SECRET, tokens will be signed with '' silently. Consider failing fast at startup.

CORS is configured with allow_credentials=True AND allow_origins='*'. Since auth is Bearer-token (not cookies) this works, but it's a smell — if the team later adds cookie-auth, browsers will reject. Make CORS_ORIGINS an explicit list in prod.
Analytics endpoint has no rate-limit or bot-filter. Anyone can spam /api/analytics/event and inflate the dashboard. Low priority for skeleton, but flag for future.

analytics_utils.parse_user_agent has a Python precedence bug: `'mobi' in ua or 'iphone' in ua or 'android' in ua and 'mobile' in ua` — `and` binds tighter than `or`, so iPhone correctly matches via 'iphone' but Android tablets won't be classified as tablet since any 'android' hit with 'mobile' falls through to mobile. Not a functional bug for analytics purposes; noted for polish.
bland_client.configure_inbound_number strips leading '+' and '1' — fine for US numbers but will break for international E.164. Document or broaden once real number is added.
test_credentials: admin@brivomarketing.com / BrivoOps2026! (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Valid JWT login confirmed.
seed_data_creation: Created test inquiries (TEST_ / pw_ prefixes) and analytics events in Mongo during flow tests. Non-destructive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: 20 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covering inquiry/roi/analytics/auth/leads-patch/analytics-summary/operator-status/operator-toggle/outbound-call-503/calls-list/webhook. Run via: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. Bland.ai is skeleton — BLAND_API_KEY empty — so /api/admin/operator/call returns 503 and /toggle enabled=true returns 400 (no inbound number). These are the intended 'not configured' responses. Admin seeded on every startup from backend/.env. If the user later adds BLAND_* keys, re-test operator_toggle and operator_outbound_call — those two tests will need to be relaxed/changed.
